headline: Dover Lifts Full-Year 2026 Adjusted EPS Floor to $10.60
summary: Dover Corporation raised its full-year adjusted EPS floor to $10.60 and increased its organic growth forecast to 5% following a 16% year-over-year rise in third-quarter bookings.
why: Dover is a diversified global industrial manufacturer whose bookings are monitored as a gauge of industrial demand.

impacts.name: Dover Corporation
impacts.why: Higher bookings and raised full-year earnings guidance enhance near-term revenue visibility.
